paxNotes.text: 6–10 pax: airport service perlu kenderaan bagasi tambahan (ProdReq 5.2) — sudah dalam kadar airport transfer band 6–10 pax
10–13 pax (Solati): kadar 8.6 adalah driver sahaja — Korean Tour Guide RM 1,297/hari sudah ditambah sendiri dalam kadar hari extension. Rujuk tab Transportation & Guide.
9 pax ke atas: bundle driving guide (1–8 pax) tidak terpakai — perlu driver + tour guide berasingan (ProdReq 5.6 & 12); kadar hari extension sudah ikut band ini

validity: Validity of Quotation: This quotation is valid for 24 hours from the date of issue and is subject to hotel and room availability as no space has been secured. Price is based on 2–3 persons per room. A deposit of RM 500 per pax is required upon confirmation, with full payment due 45 days before the departure date; payment must be made in cash. A late booking surcharge of RM 50 per booking applies if the booking is made less than 45 days before departure. Airport transfer allows a maximum of 1 luggage per pax. The final itinerary is confirmed 14 days before the trip. Package is valid for travel until 30 June 2027. Ground arrangement and tipping only — international flight tickets are not included.
